title: Gamma-squeeze candidate retail-pressure event study

data.source: yfinance daily adjusted close and volume

method.pressure_proxy: return_t * volume_z_t, where volume_z_t compares volume_t to the prior 60 trading days
method.lookahead_policy: raw pressure is observed after close t; event_signal = raw_event.shift(1); forward windows begin at t+1 tradable date

multiple_testing.family: 2 event types x 3 horizons x 2 primary metrics (rv_jump_pct, car) = 12 tests
multiple_testing.main_p_value_basis: date-clustered sign-flip p-value; same-date cross-ticker events are averaged before testing

notes: This is not a true dealer-gamma test: free yfinance data has no options open interest, customer direction, or dealer gamma exposure.
The proxy captures high-volume signed price pressure in retail/gamma candidate stocks.
Matched controls are same-symbol, same-year when available, excluding nearby event days.
All statistical claims must respect the 12-test Bonferroni family in summary.multiple_testing.
